theme: 3 terms on protocols in depth: joining protocols with an ampersand, a protocol only classes can adopt, and a requirement that uses the adopting type itself

terms.definition: Joining protocols with an ampersand, like `Named & Aged`, so a value must conform to all of them.
terms.example: Use Protocol Composition here instead of one giant protocol.

terms.definition: A protocol that inherits from `AnyObject`, so only classes can adopt it and you can hold it weakly.
terms.example: Make the delegate a Class Only Protocol, so we can store it as `weak`.

terms.definition: A protocol requirement that uses `Self`, meaning the exact type that adopts the protocol.
terms.example: Because of the Self Requirement, `mix` only accepts the same type.

video.title: Protocol Composition, Class Only Protocol & Self Requirement | Day 64
video.description:
Learn to explain protocols in depth: Protocol Composition, Class Only Protocol & Self Requirement, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Protocol Composition - Joining protocols with an ampersand, like `Named & Aged`, so a value must conform to all of them.
Class Only Protocol - A protocol that inherits from `AnyObject`, so only classes can adopt it and you can hold it weakly.
Self Requirement - A protocol requirement that uses `Self`, meaning the exact type that adopts the protocol.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.title: Swift Protocol Composition, Class Only Protocol & Self Requirement | Day 64
landscape.description:
Explain Protocol Composition, Class Only Protocol & Self Requirement in Swift by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
프로토콜 합성, 클래스 전용 프로토콜, Self 요구사항 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Protocol Composition - Joining protocols with an ampersand, like `Named & Aged`, so a value must conform to all of them.
한국어: 프로토콜 합성: `Named & Aged`처럼 앰퍼샌드로 프로토콜을 묶어, 값이 모두를 따르도록 하는 것

Class Only Protocol - A protocol that inherits from `AnyObject`, so only classes can adopt it and you can hold it weakly.
한국어: 클래스 전용 프로토콜: `AnyObject`를 상속해서 클래스만 채택할 수 있고 weak로 보관할 수 있는 프로토콜

Self Requirement - A protocol requirement that uses `Self`, meaning the exact type that adopts the protocol.
한국어: Self 요구사항: 프로토콜을 채택하는 바로 그 타입을 뜻하는 `Self`를 쓰는 요구사항

In this video, Mina and Jake read three small protocols: one joined with an ampersand, one only classes can adopt and one that talks about its own type, in a chat-style conversation, with the Swift code on screen.

landscape.hook: Can you explain these three protocol tricks in English?

dialogue.title: What's the ampersand?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That's Protocol Composition. `x` must be `Saving` and `Syncing` at the same time.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Small ones are easier to reuse. Protocol Composition joins them only where needed.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That makes it a Class Only Protocol. Only classes can adopt it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So a struct can't adopt it?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right. With a Class Only Protocol, you can keep a weak reference to it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And capital `Self` in `Merge`? What does that mean?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It's a Self Requirement. `mix` must take and return the adopting type itself.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Got it. With a Self Requirement, two notes merge into a note, not something else.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What's the ampersand between those protocols?
